plan: [This is a second-price (Vickrey) auction with independent private values. Dominant strategy is to bid truthfully: bid your value to maximize expected surplus, since if you win you pay the second-highest bid. Ties are random but bidding your true value avoids missed profitable wins. My private value is $14, so I will bid $14. ]

[This is a sealed-bid second-price auction (Vickrey) with three bidders. Truthful bidding (bid = my private value) is a dominant strategy and maximizes expected payoff. I will bid my value of $34. Ties are resolved randomly, but bidding truthfully protects long-run profit given independent draws and one-shot play.]

[This is a second-price sealed-bid auction with independent draws and no prior rounds to learn from. In such auctions, bidding your true valuation is a weakly dominant strategy and maximizes expected profit. My private value is $33, so I will bid $33. Ties are unlikely and resolved randomly, but truthful bidding remains optimal.]
